page.overview:
Who is Afro?

Afro is a character in the Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's manga. He was a contestant in the D1 Grand Prix.

Afro was among the other D1 Grand Prix contestants during the opening of the event. He was surprised when Jack patronizes the contestants, saying the Grand Prix seems to just be a consolation tournament.

Afro's first Duel is against Kalin Kessler, which he loses with a direct attack from Kalin's "Infernity General". He was unable to inflict any damage to Kalin during the Duel.
